I replied to Pree in the #central-team thread. I logged the 8 April renewal date for Brackenwater Freight Co. as unverified hearsay and didn't change any records. I suggested checking it against the contract or with the account owner before anyone relies on it.

I didn't compare it with an official renewal date. My file lookup came back with unrelated notes and digests, and none of them were Brackenwater's account files.
